name: Vercel MCP
tagline: Manage Vercel deployments, projects, and environment variables.
shortDescription: The official Vercel MCP server. List projects, trigger deployments, read logs, manage environment variables, and roll back releases. The right tool for any agent that touches your Vercel-hosted apps.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Vercel MCP server, maintained by Vercel. Exposes Vercel's API as MCP tools: list projects, get deployment details, trigger a new deployment, list environment variables, read function logs, and roll back to a previous deployment.

## Why we recommend it

If you deploy with Vercel (and most AI-adjacent teams do), this is the cleanest way to give an agent the ability to inspect what's deployed, trigger a redeploy, or check a build log. The auth is scoped to a single Vercel token with the permissions you specify, and the read-only default keeps things safe.

## When to use it

- Debugging "why did this deploy fail?" without leaving chat
- Triggering a manual redeploy after a config change
- Pulling environment variable lists (for audit or onboarding)
- Reading production logs when investigating a user report
installInstructions:
1. Create a Vercel access token at https://vercel.com/account/tokens (scope it to the team or projects you want the agent to access)
2. Set `VERCEL_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @vercel/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Vercel hosting has a free tier and paid plans starting at $20/mo per member.
